config.hypothesis:
Even if agency/body membership is imperfect under adversarial correlation,
the present embodiment stack should revise its causal model selectively when
real physical coupling changes, while remaining comparatively stable under a
sham intervention.
config.success_criteria:
Across preregistered seeds, revision rate for output permutation, silent
effector failure and body transplant must each be >= 0.70; sham must be quieter
than real causal changes in >= 0.70 of seeds; replay must be deterministic.
Passing E4 does not repair failures in E1 or E5.
config.title: E4 Sham, Permutation, Break, Transplant
